OCEAN OBSERVATION / BUOY

HY-FB-GX01

Long-term measurements from a stable platform.

A 2 m moored buoy for long-term optical, water-quality and weather observation, designed to stay level in wind and waves.

Compare all equipment

Configuration checks

  • Select the measured parameters; the data logger is a custom module.
  • Confirm mooring design for the site depth, tide and current.
  • Decide where data is stored; cloud hosting is optional and local storage should be available.

COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than
the vehicle.

The system includes the mooring, a custom data logger, wireless transmission, battery and solar panels, data-receiving software and watertight cables. Measured parameters can include air temperature, pressure, wind, humidity, solar radiation, water temperature, conductivity, salinity, turbidity and chlorophyll. Radio certification for the target country is confirmed per project.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Buoy body, mooring and watertight cabling
  • Data logger and selected sensors
  • Wireless transmission, battery and solar power
  • Data software and platform
  • Deployment, calibration plan and maintenance schedule

Standard, optional and custom items must be listed separately in the quotation.

QUESTIONS

Before you specify the HY-FB-GX01.

What does it measure?

The logger is configured per project. The catalogue lists weather (air temperature, pressure, wind, humidity, solar radiation) and water parameters (temperature, conductivity, salinity, turbidity, chlorophyll and other water-quality data).

Where does the data go?

The data platform offers real-time display, maps and user permissions, with optional cloud service. Agree local storage and data ownership before deployment.
